sn11.2:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn11.2:2.2: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo susimaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi
sn11.2:2.3: ete tāta susima asurā deve abhiyanti
sn11.2:2.5: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho bhikkhave susimo devaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā pamādaṃ āpādesi.
sn11.2:2.6: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo susimaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi …pe…
sn11.2:2.8: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo susimaṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi ete tāta susima asurā deve abhiyanti gaccha tāta susima asure paccuyyāhīti. evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho bhikkhave susimo devaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā
sn11.2:2.10: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo susimaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn11.2:8.1: so hi nāma bhikkhave sakko devānamindo sakaṃ puññaphalaṃ upajīvamāno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kārento uṭṭhānaviriyassa vaṇṇavādī bhavissati.
sn11.2:8.2: idha khvetaṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā uṭṭhaheyyātha ghaṭeyyātha vāyameyyātha appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
